sources.entry: Keyboard Maestro - Automate repetitive tasks with triggers and macros.

summary.name: Keyboard Maestro
summary.one_liner: Keyboard Maestro is a macOS automation app that runs macros triggered by keystrokes, schedules, or commands to automate apps, web pages, text, and images.
use_cases: Expanding text snippets and typing email addresses
Filling in web forms and downloading bank statements or reports
Arranging windows and launching apps at login or on a schedule
Transforming text and filtering clipboard history
Building multi-application reporting and end-of-month processes
summary.what_it_does: Keyboard Maestro lets users build macros that automate applications, web sites, text, and images, triggered on command or on a schedule. Actions can be combined with flow control, conditions, and loops. Documented capabilities include launching apps and arranging windows, OCR of images, text transformation, calculations, clipboard filtering with multi-entry history, and downloading files. A macro can prompt for information such as name, time, and location and combine it into text. A Security Settings pane shows the status of macOS permissions the app needs.
notable: Version 11 is a one-time purchase with no subscription, usable indefinitely
Combines triggers, conditions, flow control and loops across apps and the web
Paid upgrades from earlier versions; purchases since 1 March 2023 get a free upgrade to version 11
caveats: Version 11 costs US$36 plus applicable tax (asterisked on page; exact terms not stated in the text)
Requires macOS 10.13 High Sierra or later; older OS X versions need an old release
